title: Webhook Delivery Scheduler
goal: Deliver the webhook scheduler through this interactive coding session. Incorporate every steering message and staged requirement file, preserve supplied tests, and use only the standard library. Keep the goal active until the user sends `REQUIREMENTS LOCKED`. Then run the full suite, fix failures, call `await goal.complete()`, and respond exactly `WEBHOOK GOAL COMPLETE`.
